title: Two-choice effect settings are a segmented control, as the fields mock draws them
goal: A shadow's Kind (Drop or Inner), a glow's Kind (Outer or Inner) and a label border's Follows (Letters or Box) each offer only two choices, but open a dropdown. The user's fields mock says two choices are a segmented control, never a dropdown, so both answers are on screen and one click switches them.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/comp-fields.html section 05 Select: "For 5 or more exclusive options, or fewer when space is tight. Below that use a .seg" and the dont: "Use a select for two options. That is a segmented control." Found 2026-10-05 by the-appearance-and-effects-menus-wear-the-same-d while comparing against the mock; that task moved these rows from the system pop-up onto VideoKit.Dropdown (EffectsListInspector.swift BorderFollowsRow, GlowKindRow, ShadowKindRow; EffectStylePanel.picker). Use SegmentedControl (Sources/Photonz/DesignSystem), never Picker .segmented (UX-PATTERNS: The one segmented control). Walks that choose these today: label-border-follows-walk (panelMenu Follows), appearance-and-effects-dropdowns-open-on-a-click-walk (panelMenu Kind/Follows/Position at centre/start/end); remove those panelMenu steps from the click walk and lower EveryDropdownIsClickedByAWalkTests.builtNames if Kind/Position leave the style panel dropdown.
acceptance: Shadow Kind, Glow Kind and Follows in the Effects list, and Kind on a saved effect style, are the app's one segmented control with both choices showing, at Next defaults
Mixed still reads as Mixed (no segment picked) and picking either gives it to every picked layer in one undo step
Position (three choices) and Masked by stay dropdowns only if three segments do not fit the effect row's control column in the narrowest panel; the audit says which and why
A walk clicks each segment with the pointer, and the walks that pick these today pass
